description: Set the hex code of a color characteristic value. The value must already exist among the store's characteristic values (see list_characteristic_colors) — this endpoint recolors an existing value, it does not create one. Both fields are required.

color_hex.description: Color as a hex code (e.g. "#FF0000") or one of the special values "multicoloured" / "transparent".

value.description: Characteristic value to recolor, exactly as it is stored (e.g. «Красный»).

name: update_characteristic_color
title: Update characteristic color
